fields.helpText: Title in Google and when the case page is shared, up to 60 characters. Fill for every project with a case study.
Description in Google and when the page is shared, up to 155 characters. Fill for every project with a case study.
Case page headline, one sentence. Filled = the project has a case study: Trusted and Home hero cards open /our-work/<slug> and get the info icon.
Top of the client's homepage, landscape, about 1600x1000. Our Work slider picture, case page image and the preview when the page is shared.
Main result, short, e.g. 16x, 80+, 2 weeks. Our Work grid, slider and tabs, Home Every project, Resources and next-project cards, first number in the case page hero.
What Stat 1 means, 2 to 4 words, e.g. Engagement time growth.
Second number in the case page hero, e.g. 30+.
What Stat 2 means, e.g. Pages launched.
Short industry tag, 1 to 3 words, e.g. Legal tech, Fintech, Agriculture. Shown on every card and in the case page hero.

Full address of the client's live site, e.g. https://www.ballerine.com. 'Visit website' button on the case page; Trusted cards without a case study open it. Its domain (without https:// and www.) shows in the Our Work slider and under the Every project gallery.
Case page sidebar 'Services used': pick the services we did for this project. Each row opens that service's page.
Case page: who the client is and where they started. 1 to 2 paragraphs.
Case page: what had to be solved. 1 to 2 paragraphs.
Case page: what we built. Subheadings and lists are fine.
Case page: the outcome. 1 to 2 paragraphs.
Case page: key results as a bulleted list.
Case page gallery, middle card: collage of page screens. Portrait 2:3, 1041x1560 WebP, from the Figma card Frame 47796.
Case page gallery, right card: phone mockup. Portrait 2:3, 1041x1560 WebP, from the Figma card Frame 47797.

White logo, SVG with a transparent background, made by the designer. The one logo used everywhere: Trusted cards (shown grey before hover), Home Every project, Our Work grid and tabs, Resources cards and the case page.
One short result line on the Trusted card, about 30 characters, e.g. 3x organic traffic.
Position in the Trusted strip, Our Work grid and Resources, lowest first: 1, 2, 3... Use each number once.

On = logo card in the Trusted strip (Home and service pages). Needs Logo white, Card text, Order (the grey logo before hover is made from Logo white). With Case title the card opens the case page, else Website link.
On = slide in the Home 'Every project' slider (sorted by Name). Needs Logo white, Card background, Every project screens and page names, Full page screenshot, Stat 1 and Story label.
Screenshots of the client's pages in order (first = Home), about 2400px wide. Shown on the slide and in the gallery popup.

One sentence about the project, e.g. How nues rebuilt compliance into a site the marketing team runs alone. Our Work tabs (first third of the words dark, the rest grey) and Home Every project, above Stat 1.
Optional. Last words of Case title shown in the mint gradient, e.g. now runs on its own. Must match the end of Case title exactly.
Optional third number in the case page hero, e.g. 0.9s. Empty = Industry is shown in its place.
What Stat 3 means, e.g. Page load on mobile.
Whole homepage as one tall image, 1440px wide, JPG/WebP under 8 MB. Cards, Resources, Every project and case page hero. Empty = card shows 'Launching soon'.
Optional. Inner page screenshot, about 900px wide, for the left frame of the case page hero. The three frames take turns in the middle.
Optional. Inner page screenshot, about 900px wide, for the right frame of the case page hero.
Optional. Client quote without quotation marks. Empty = no quote block on the case page.
Full name of the person quoted, e.g. Or Moshkovitz. The handwritten signature under the quote is made from it (Or M.).
Role and company, e.g. CMO, Ballerine.
Optional. Square client symbol, at least 128x128, shown above the quote.
On = slide in the browser slider at the top of Our Work. Needs Cover image, Logo color, Industry, Stat 1 and Website link (the address bar shows it without https:// and www.).
On = tab in 'What they had. What we shipped.' on Our Work (sorted by Name). Needs Logo white, Tabs background, Before and After screenshot, Website link (address bar), Story label and Stat 1.
Old site, top of the homepage, cut from the top to 1.75:1 (e.g. 2400x1371 WebP). Left side of the before/after slider in the Our Work tabs.
New site, same view and the same 1.75:1 shape as Before screenshot, cut from the top. Right side of the before/after slider.
Which filter tab on the Our Work page shows this project. Pick one.
Logo in the client's brand colours, SVG with a transparent background. Shown in the Our Work slider (light background).
Names of the screens above, same order, comma separated, e.g. Home, Platform, Pricing. Captions in the gallery popup.

16:10, 1600x1000: client colours with their big soft mark. Background of the Our Work grid, Resources and next-project cards and the Home Every project slide. Without it the project is not in the Our Work grid.
Optional. Direct link to a short muted MP4/WebM loop (2140x1280, under 5 MB), not a YouTube/Vimeo page. Plays over Cover image; empty = Cover image for 6 s.
Case page 'The team behind this project': pick everyone who worked on it, in the order to show. Each card opens that person's LinkedIn.
Case page gallery, left card: laptop mockup. Portrait 2:3, 1041x1560 WebP, exported by the designer from the Figma card Frame 47795.
Background behind the before/after window in the Our Work tabs: client colours with soft light stripes, landscape 3:2 from the designer (2400x1600 WebP).
Not used for now (skill pills are off on the case page).
Not used for now (skill pills are off on the case page).
Not used for now (skill pills are off on the case page).
Not used for now (skill pills are off on the case page).
Client name, e.g. Ballerine. Shown as the project name and used as image alt text everywhere.
Case page address /our-work/<slug>, e.g. ballerine. Lowercase, no spaces. Do not change it once the page is live.
